gaps.sentence: She glanced ___ her watch and stood up.
She's perfectly capable ___ managing the project alone.
They congratulated her ___ passing her driving test.
The kids are crazy ___ the new video game.
gaps.explanation: crazy ABOUT something = love it enthusiastically.

gaps.sentence: Fast charging is a big advantage ___ this model.
The committee does not approve ___ the changes.
gaps.explanation: Verb: approve OF something (noun 'approval' has no preposition).

gaps.sentence: The minister refused to comment ___ the scandal.
The song reminds me ___ my first holiday abroad.
gaps.explanation: remind somebody OF something = make them remember; remind somebody ABOUT = tell them not to forget.
